verdict.rationale: NVIDIA ships official, buildable SDKs. Isaac Sim provides Python namespace packages installable via pip to compose apps, and is extensible for building custom OpenUSD simulators. Isaac Lab is an open-source framework that accepts custom RL libraries, and Isaac ROS offers ready-to-use packages, with an official GitHub repo backing the Sim components. Missing for 10: API reference depth or SDK documentation detail beyond marketing and install pages, any language bindings beyond Python and ROS, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against these SDKs.
